hazards.control: Guards on exhaust and hydraulic lines; keep clear of engine compartments while running.
Hearing protection near running pumps and blenders.

name: Engine and radiator
function: The prime mover on the trailer deck that turns the transmission and the power end.

tabs.overview: A large diesel engine with its radiator and exhaust, controlled from the data van through the pump controller; dual-fuel engines burn natural gas with diesel pilot, and electric fleets replace the engine with a motor and a variable-frequency drive.
tabs.engineering: Rated to drive the pump at its horsepower; cooling sized for continuous duty in summer.
tabs.safety: Hot exhaust and surfaces; fuel handling.
tabs.evidence: Public equipment overviews (S22), public simultaneous-frac articles (S17, S18, S19), field practice (S9). Rates and horsepower are typical values, not a design basis.
